description: RE/MAX US homes for sale in a ZIP code (or a city by its Census place ID) from remax.com search pages: listing ID, MLS number and MLS name, address, price, beds, baths, living area (sq ft), lot (acres), property type, banners (new listing, open house...), open-house times, listing office and courtesy line, photo and URL; 24 per page plus the total count. MLS IDX data, for consumer use. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

placeId.description: 7-digit Census place GEOID of the city, e.g. 4805000 for Austin TX

zip.description: 5-digit ZIP code, e.g. 78704 (give zip, or city + placeId)
